neowiki-main-page-text: This wiki records structured data with [https://neowiki.ai NeoWiki]: each Subject describes one thing, such as a person or an artwork, with the properties its Schema defines. {{#create_subject: page=new}} == Getting started == * [[Special:UserLogin|Log in]], then create your first Subject with the button above. If no Schema fits yet, create one in the dialog the button opens. * The [[Special:NeoWiki|NeoWiki overview]], with your Schemas and recent Subjects, is in the NeoWiki section of the Tools menu on every page. == Help and feedback == * In the [https://neowiki.ai/docs/guide/getting-started Getting started guide], you create a Schema and a Subject, show the Subject on a page, and query your data. * The [https://neowiki.ai/docs/glossary NeoWiki glossary] explains Subjects, Schemas and other terms. * Questions and feedback go to the [https://github.com/ProfessionalWiki/NeoWiki/issues NeoWiki issue tracker]. == For administrators == * Before adding data, choose whether this wiki is page-first or subject-first on the [{{fullurl:MediaWiki:NeoWiki}} NeoWiki settings page]. * Replace this page with an introduction to your wiki.
